def _account_payload(self, db: Session, row: AiCreditAccount) -> dict:
        credential = db.get(ManagedModelCredential, row.managed_credential_id)
        wallet_total = int(row.wallet_total_units)
        asr_reserved = int(row.asr_reserved_units)
        asr_committed = int(row.asr_committed_units)
        omnihi_used = self._units(row.confirmed_budget_used)
        return {
            "accountRef": row.public_ref,
            "productName": self._product_name(db, credential),
            "totalUnits": wallet_total,
            "usedUnits": omnihi_used + asr_committed,
            "frozenUnits": self._units(row.confirmed_budget_frozen),
            "remainingUnits": max(
                0,
                wallet_total - omnihi_used - asr_committed - asr_reserved,
            ),
            "pendingUnits": self._units(
                row.target_budget_amount - row.confirmed_budget_amount
            ),
            "syncStatus": row.sync_status,
            "updatedAt": row.updated_at,
            "lastUsageRefreshedAt": row.last_usage_refreshed_at,
        }
